purpose: Diagnostic slice definition only. Ids and canonical question texts are the real AUZEF KB values (same list as backend/tests/test_selector_v2.py NEAR_QNA_PAIRS); the snapshot generator re-verifies them against the live KB. No answers are stored here and no benchmark case is synthesized from this file: a Gold case joins the near_qna slice only when one member is acceptable and the other member is present in its frozen candidate set.
relation_note: relation=general_specific only where the specific question adds an explicit qualifier the general one lacks (the Selector prompt's own general/specific example is 129 vs 342). This is a harness classification of the canonical questions, not a dataset tag.
